title: Core Practice Sheet System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a child-friendly worksheet system and extend it across sound sorting, blending, syllable pacing, and guided-reading practice.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the worksheet grid, icon language, answer zones, and color-coding rhythm. Images 02-04 preserve the same page structure and classroom print realism while changing the exercise logic.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-sound-sheet first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-vowel-blend-sheet, 03-syllable-clap-sheet, 04-guided-reading-sheet. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-sound-sheet is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
